sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), CHECK (type IN ('cash', 'bank', 'card', 'wallet', 'pf', 'other')), CHECK (length(colour) BETWEEN 1 AND 32), CHECK (typeof(opening_balance) = 'integer' AND opening_balance BETWEEN -100000000000000 AND 100000000000000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), CHECK (kind IN ('expense', 'income')), CHECK (colour_group IN ('essentials', 'food', 'transport', 'home', 'lifestyle', 'health', 'family', 'finance', 'other', 'income')), CHECK (length(icon) BETWEEN 1 AND 40));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (direction IN ('lent', 'borrowed')), CHECK (length(trim(person)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), CHECK (typeof(principal) = 'integer' AND principal > 0 AND principal <= 100000000000000), CHECK (length(start_date) = 10 AND date(start_date) IS start_date), CHECK (due_date IS NULL OR (length(due_date) = 10 AND date(due_date) IS due_date AND due_date >= start_date)), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 200));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_account_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "loan_id" TEXT NULL, "import_source" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income', 'transfer')), CHECK (typeof(amount) = 'integer' AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 100000000000000), CHECK (length(date) = 10 AND date(date) IS date), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 200), CHECK (import_source IS NULL OR length(import_source) <= 120), CHECK ((type = 'transfer' AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id <> account_id AND category_id IS NULL AND loan_id IS NULL) OR (type IN ('expense', 'income') AND to_account_id IS NULL AND category_id IS NOT NULL)), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (to_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (loan_id) REFERENCES loans (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(month) = 7 AND date(month || '-01') IS month || '-01'), CHECK (typeof(amount) = 'integer' AND amount > 0 AND amount <= 100000000000000), FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gold_holdings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_mg" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purity" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), CHECK (typeof(weight_mg) = 'integer' AND weight_mg > 0 AND weight_mg <= 100000000), CHECK (purity IN ('24k', '22k', '18k')), CHECK (length(purchase_date) = 10 AND date(purchase_date) IS purchase_date), CHECK (typeof(purchase_price) = 'integer' AND purchase_price >= 0 AND purchase_price <= 100000000000000), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gold_rates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "purity" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_per_gram" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(date) = 10 AND date(date) IS date), CHECK (purity IN ('24k', '22k', '18k')), CHECK (typeof(rate_per_gram) = 'integer' AND rate_per_gram > 0 AND rate_per_gram <= 1000000000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 36), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at) = 'integer'), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(updated_at) = 'integer' AND updated_at >= created_at), "deleted_at" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR typeof(deleted_at) = 'integer'), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sync_status IN ('pending', 'synced')), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(date) = 10 AND date(date) IS date), CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 1000));
